remarks: Step into the perfect blend of charm and modern upgrades with this Cape Cod gem! The newly renovated kitchen shines with shaker-style cabinetry, Bosch appliances, and premium finishes, while both renovated bathrooms feature luxurious Rohl and Waterworks fixtures. Enjoy seamless indoor-outdoor living with a versatile first-floor layout (3rd bedroom/den/office) and sliders lead to a lovely patio-ideal for relaxing or entertaining. The flat and enclosed back yard ensures privacy.  A newly constructed 16' x 32' detached, climate-controlled structure currently serves as a gym but can easily transform into a home office or studio. A new sprinkler system keeps the yard vibrant, and the home's convenient location near the train and shopping ensures easy living. Don't miss this opportunity! (prefer a longer close end of June or even July/August)
